checks.title: Confirm export scope
checks.instructions: Agree on reporting period, jurisdiction, currency, and recipient. Record stable preferences in MEMORY.md.

checks.title: Verify the skill
checks.instructions: Confirm skills/tax-export/SKILL.md exists and tax-export is selected for this Crew.

checks.title: Verify records
checks.instructions: Locate authorized invoices, payments, or accounting exports and confirm they cover the agreed period. An upload is sufficient; an MCP is optional.

checks.title: Agree on fields, signs and categories
checks.instructions: Confirm recipient format, legal entity, required columns, accounting/tax basis, currency/FX source, date cutoff, original-to-normalized sign rule and classification policy with the owner or tax professional. Leave tax codes and missing fields blank/pending instead of guessing.

checks.title: Reconcile a sample
checks.instructions: Verify a payment, linked refund or reversal, processor fee and payout/deposit when available. Check source IDs/versions, duplicates, gaps, totals and tolerance; avoid counting a bank transfer as a second sale. Record unresolved exceptions.

checks.title: Review the first export
checks.instructions: Produce a traceable sample export, source-to-column mapping, signed-amount calculation, reconciliation note and exceptions list. Complete only after the owner reviews them against the recipient's required format.

checks.title: Decide on handoff
checks.instructions: Ask whether to keep results in Crew chat or use an approved secure delivery route. Choosing chat-only completes this decision. Do not send without authorization.

checks.title: Decide on recurrence
checks.instructions: Ask if a schedule or authenticated new-record trigger is needed. Choosing neither completes this decision; if requested, test before enabling.
